facts.business: Tejas Networks is a pioneering R&D-driven telecom and networking equipment company delivering high-performance wireline and wireless networking solutions to customers across more than 75 countries.
facts.related_party_note: Related parties include Ultimate Holding Company Tata Sons Private Limited, Holding Company Panatone Finvest Limited, and various subsidiaries and associates of the Tata Group with whom the Group has transactions.
